_doc: Redragon M690 PRO. Same receiver IDs (258a:002e/002f) and framing as the M811 PRO, model marker 0x13 (public notes from the OpenMouse project; facts only, no code). Wyrm names it and shows battery and connection, but doesn't configure it yet: its stage DPI is an index into a vendor table that hasn't been mapped. A dump per DPI value would unlock it; see docs/adding-a-device.md.
name: Redragon M690 PRO
